不要禁止他们；因为在天国的，
正是这样的人。」

and don’t forbid them to come to me; for the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to ones like these.”

正是這樣的人。」
But Jesus said
“Allow the little children
and don’t forbid them to come to me; for the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to ones like these.”
But Jesus said
Let the little ones come to me
and do not keep them away: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.

But seek first God’s Kingdom
and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.
Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow
for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.
But let your first care be for his kingdom and his righteousness; and all these other things will be given to you in addition.
Then have no care for tomorrow: tomorrow will take care of itself. Take the trouble of the day as it comes.

when he heard the message spoken
immediately said to the ruler of the synagogue
“Don’t be afraid
only believe.”

when he heard the message spoken
immediately said to the ruler of the synagogue
“Don’t be afraid
only believe.”
But Jesus
giving no attention to their words
said to the ruler of the Synagogue
Have no fear
only have faith.

求主帮助。」
Immediately the father of the child cried out with tears
“I believe. Help my unbelief!”

求主幫助。」

“I believe. Help my unbelief!”
Straight away the father of the child gave a cry
saying
I have faith; make my feeble faith stronger.

but he who keeps his mouth shut does wisely.

the nation falls
but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.

but with a number of wise guides they will be safe.
